content.title: U.S. Chip Tariffs to Have Limited Impact on Taiwanese Companies
content.summary: The latest U.S. semiconductor tariffs will likely have minimal impact on Taiwanese chip companies, Citi analysts said in a research note.  President Donald Trump said on Wednesday that he would impose roughly 100% tariffs on all chips coming into the U.S., but exempt tech companies that promise to manufacture in the country.  Many chips from Taiwan aren't shipped directly to the U.S., instead arriving through downstream assembly and testing partners, the analysts said.
